Builder canvas list rows, not cards. The 3px left bar is transparent by default and encodes three states (is-selected / is-error / is-dropover), each paired with a background fill, so selection is never carried by colour alone.

Not a UI card: this is the border-left:4px on a <blockquote> inside the job-application HTML EMAIL template. A left rule on a blockquote is the standard quoting convention and one of the few layout devices that renders reliably across Outlook/Gmail, where flexbox and modern CSS are unavailable. Category error, not an AI-UI side-tab.
